create_diaglinear_bijector: create a DiagLinear bijector with a diagonal vector for element-wise linear transformation
forward_diaglinear: compute the forward transformation y=Ax using a DiagLinear bijector on input x
inverse_diaglinear: compute the inverse transformation x=A-inverse y using a DiagLinear bijector
forward_and_log_det_diaglinear: compute the forward transformation and log determinant of the Jacobian together
diaglinear_matrix_property: get the full diagonal matrix A from a DiagLinear bijector using the matrix property
